auxGetDevCaps@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the capabilities of an auxiliary output device into an AUXCAPS structure. Returns MMSYSERR_NOERROR on success.

auxSetVolume@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the volume of an auxiliary output device; the low word of dwVolume is the left channel and the high word the right channel (0 to &HFFFF).

auxGetVolume@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the current volume setting of an auxiliary output device into lpdwVolume (low word left channel, high word right channel).

auxOutMessage@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sends a message directly to an auxiliary output device driver. Returns the value returned by the driver.

timeGetSystemTime@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the system time in milliseconds since Windows started into an MMTIME structure. Same as timeGetTime but uses a structure.

timeGetTime@WIN32API.INC.desc: Returns the system time in milliseconds since Windows was started. The value wraps around to 0 every 2^32 milliseconds (about 49.7 days).

timeSetEvent@WIN32API.INC.desc: Starts a multimedia timer that calls a callback function once or periodically after uDelay milliseconds. Returns a timer ID, or 0 on failure. Obsolete; use CreateTimerQueueTimer.

timeKillEvent@WIN32API.INC.desc: Cancels a multimedia timer event started with timeSetEvent, identified by its timer ID.

timeGetDevCaps@WIN32API.INC.desc: Queries the timer device for its minimum and maximum supported resolution, returned in a TIMECAPS structure.

timeBeginPeriod@WIN32API.INC.desc: Requests a minimum resolution, in milliseconds, for periodic timers. Must be matched by a call to timeEndPeriod with the same value.

timeEndPeriod@WIN32API.INC.desc: Clears a minimum timer resolution previously set with timeBeginPeriod; pass the same value used in that call.

joyGetDevCaps@WIN32API.INC.desc: Queries a joystick to determine its capabilities, returned in a JOYCAPS structure.

joyGetNumDevs@WIN32API.INC.desc: Returns the number of joysticks supported by the current joystick driver (not the number attached). Note: the source alias joyGetNumDev is misspelled; the export is joyGetNumDevs.

joyGetThreshold@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the movement threshold of a joystick, i.e. the distance it must move before a WM_JOYMOVE message is sent.

joyReleaseCapture@WIN32API.INC.desc: Releases joystick capture previously set with joySetCapture for the specified joystick.

joySetCapture@WIN32API.INC.desc: Captures a joystick so its messages are sent to the specified window, polling at the given period in milliseconds.

joySetThreshold@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the movement threshold of a joystick, the distance it must move before a WM_JOYMOVE message is sent.

mmioStringToFOURCC@WIN32API.INC.desc: Converts a null-terminated string of up to four characters into a four-character code (FOURCC) used in RIFF files.

mmioOpen@WIN32API.INC.desc: Opens a file for unbuffered or buffered multimedia I/O (including RIFF files). Returns an HMMIO handle, or 0 on failure.

mmioRename@WIN32API.INC.desc: Renames the specified file using the multimedia I/O file system.

mmioClose@WIN32API.INC.desc: Closes a file that was opened with mmioOpen.

mmioRead@WIN32API.INC.desc: Reads a specified number of bytes from a file opened with mmioOpen. Returns the number of bytes read, 0 at end of file, or -1 on error.

mmioWrite@WIN32API.INC.desc: Writes a specified number of bytes to a file opened with mmioOpen. Returns the number of bytes written, or -1 on error.

mmioSeek@WIN32API.INC.desc: Changes the current file position in a file opened with mmioOpen. Returns the new position in bytes, or -1 on error.

mmioGetInfo@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves information about a file opened with mmioOpen into an MMIOINFO structure, for direct access to its I/O buffer.

mmioSetInfo@WIN32API.INC.desc: Updates the information retrieved by mmioGetInfo about a file opened with mmioOpen, ending direct buffer access.

mmioSetBuffer@WIN32API.INC.desc: Enables or disables buffered I/O, or changes the buffer or buffer size, for a file opened with mmioOpen.

mmioFlush@WIN32API.INC.desc: Writes the I/O buffer of a file to disk if the buffer has been written to.

mmioAdvance@WIN32API.INC.desc: Advances the I/O buffer of a file set up for direct buffer access, filling or flushing the buffer as needed.

mmioSendMessage@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sends a message to the I/O procedure associated with the specified file.

mmioDescend@WIN32API.INC.desc: Descends into a chunk of a RIFF file opened with mmioOpen, optionally searching for a given chunk ID, and fills an MMCKINFO structure.

mmioAscend@WIN32API.INC.desc: Ascends out of a chunk in a RIFF file that was descended into with mmioDescend or created with mmioCreateChunk.

mmioCreateChunk@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates a chunk in a RIFF file opened with mmioOpen; the new chunk is created at the current file position.

mciSendCommand@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sends a command message to the specified MCI device. Returns 0 on success or an MCI error code.

mciSendString@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sends a command string (for example "play file.wav") to an MCI device and optionally returns information in a string buffer. Returns 0 on success or an MCI error code.

mciGetCreatorTask@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves a handle to the creator task for the specified MCI device.

mciGetDeviceID@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the MCI device identifier corresponding to the name of an open device.

mciGetDeviceIDFromElementID@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the MCI device identifier corresponding to an element identifier.

mciGetErrorString@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves a string that describes the specified MCI error code.

mciExecute@WIN32API.INC.desc: Not in the Microsoft documentation: legacy winmm export that sends an MCI command string and displays a message box if an error occurs.

EnumPrinters@WIN32API.INC.desc: Enumerates available printers, print servers, domains, or print providers into an array of PRINTER_INFO structures. Returns nonzero on success.

EnumPrinterPropertySheets@WIN32API.INC.desc: Not in the Microsoft documentation: by its name, enumerates the property sheet pages of a printer.

OpenPrinter@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves a handle to the specified printer or print server. Close the handle with ClosePrinter.

ResetPrinter@WIN32API.INC.desc: Specifies the data type and device mode values used for documents submitted by StartDocPrinter; can be overridden with SetJob.

SetJob@WIN32API.INC.desc: Pauses, resumes, cancels, or restarts a print job, or sets print job parameters.

GetJob@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves information about a specified print job into a JOB_INFO structure.

EnumJobs@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves information about a specified set of print jobs for a printer.

AddPrinter@WIN32API.INC.desc: Adds a printer to the list of supported printers for a specified server. Returns a printer handle, or 0 on failure.

AddPrinterDriver@WIN32API.INC.desc: Installs a local or remote printer driver and links the configuration, data, and driver files.

EnumPrinterDrivers@WIN32API.INC.desc: Enumerates the printer drivers installed on a specified print server.

GetPrinterDriver@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves driver data for the specified printer.

GetPrinterDriverDirectory@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the path of the printer-driver directory on the specified server.

DeletePrinterDriver@WIN32API.INC.desc: Removes the specified printer-driver name from the list of names of supported drivers for a server.

AddPrintProcessor@WIN32API.INC.desc: Installs a print processor on the specified server and adds its name to the list of supported print processors.

EnumPrintProcessors@WIN32API.INC.desc: Enumerates the print processors installed on the specified server.

GetPrintProcessorDirectory@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the path to the print processor directory on the specified server.

EnumPrintProcessorDatatypes@WIN32API.INC.desc: Enumerates the data types that a specified print processor supports.

DeletePrintProcessor@WIN32API.INC.desc: Removes a print processor added by AddPrintProcessor.

StartDocPrinter@WIN32API.INC.desc: Notifies the print spooler that a document is to be spooled for printing. Returns the print job identifier, or 0 on failure.

StartPagePrinter@WIN32API.INC.desc: Notifies the spooler that a page is about to be printed on the specified printer.

WritePrinter@WIN32API.INC.desc: Notifies the print spooler that data should be written to the specified printer; returns the number of bytes written in pcWritten.

EndPagePrinter@WIN32API.INC.desc: Notifies the print spooler that the application is at the end of a page in a print job.

AbortPrinter@WIN32API.INC.desc: Deletes a printer's spool file if the printer is configured for spooling.

ReadPrinter@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves data from the specified printer (bidirectional printers).

EndDocPrinter@WIN32API.INC.desc: Ends a print job for the specified printer started with StartDocPrinter.

AddJob@WIN32API.INC.desc: Adds a print job to the list of print jobs that can be scheduled by the spooler and returns the spool file name and job ID.

ScheduleJob@WIN32API.INC.desc: Requests that the print spooler schedule a specified print job (created with AddJob) for printing.

PrinterProperties@WIN32API.INC.desc: Displays a printer-properties property sheet for the specified printer.

DocumentProperties@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves or modifies printer initialization information (DEVMODE), or displays a printer-configuration property sheet for the specified printer.

AdvancedDocumentProperties@WIN32API.INC.desc: Displays a printer-configuration dialog box for the specified printer, allowing the user to configure the printer's DEVMODE.

GetPrinterData@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves configuration data for the specified printer or print server from the registry.

SetPrinterData@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the configuration data for a printer or print server.

WaitForPrinterChange@WIN32API.INC.desc: Returns when one or more requested changes occur on a print server or printer, or when the timeout expires. Obsolete; use FindFirstPrinterChangeNotification.

PrinterMessageBox@WIN32API.INC.desc: Displays a message box on the user's system when a printer error occurs. Obsolete; no longer supported.

ClosePrinter@WIN32API.INC.desc: Closes the specified printer object handle obtained with OpenPrinter or AddPrinter.

AddForm@WIN32API.INC.desc: Adds a form to the list of available forms that can be selected for the specified printer.

DeleteForm@WIN32API.INC.desc: Removes a form name from the list of supported forms.

GetForm@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves information about a specified form into a FORM_INFO_1 structure.

SetForm@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the form information for the specified printer.

EnumForms@WIN32API.INC.desc: Enumerates the forms supported by the specified printer.

EnumMonitors@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves information about the port monitors installed on the specified server.

AddMonitor@WIN32API.INC.desc: Installs a local port monitor and links the configuration, data, and monitor files.

DeleteMonitor@WIN32API.INC.desc: Removes a port monitor added by AddMonitor.

EnumPorts@WIN32API.INC.desc: Enumerates the ports that are available for printing on a specified server.

AddPort@WIN32API.INC.desc: Adds the name of a port to the list of supported ports; displays a dialog box so the user can enter a port name. Obsolete for new code.

ConfigurePort@WIN32API.INC.desc: Displays the port-configuration dialog box for a port on the specified server. Obsolete for new code.

DeletePort@WIN32API.INC.desc: Deletes a port name; displays a dialog box to confirm the deletion. Obsolete for new code.

AddPrinterConnection@WIN32API.INC.desc: Adds a connection to the specified printer for the current user.

DeletePrinterConnection@WIN32API.INC.desc: Deletes a connection to a printer that was established by AddPrinterConnection or ConnectToPrinterDlg.

ConnectToPrinterDlg@WIN32API.INC.desc: Displays a dialog box that lets users browse and connect to printers on a network. Returns a handle to the selected printer, or 0.

AddPrintProvidor@WIN32API.INC.desc: Installs a local print provider and links the configuration, data, and provider files.

DeletePrintProvidor@WIN32API.INC.desc: Removes a print provider added by AddPrintProvidor.

WNetAddConnection@WIN32API.INC.desc: Connects a local device to a network resource. Provided for 16-bit compatibility only; use WNetAddConnection2.

WNetAddConnection2@WIN32API.INC.desc: Makes a connection to a network resource described by a NETRESOURCE structure and can redirect a local device to it. Returns NO_ERROR on success.

WNetCancelConnection@WIN32API.INC.desc: Cancels an existing network connection. Provided for 16-bit compatibility only; use WNetCancelConnection2.

WNetCancelConnection2@WIN32API.INC.desc: Cancels an existing network connection, optionally updating the persistent connection information. Returns NO_ERROR on success.

WNetGetConnection@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the name of the network resource associated with a local device (e.g. a drive letter).

WNetOpenEnum@WIN32API.INC.desc: Starts an enumeration of network resources or existing connections; returns a handle for WNetEnumResource.

WNetEnumResource@WIN32API.INC.desc: Continues an enumeration of network resources started with WNetOpenEnum, returning NETRESOURCE structures.

WNetCloseEnum@WIN32API.INC.desc: Ends a network resource enumeration started by WNetOpenEnum.

WNetGetUser@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the current default user name, or the user name used to establish a network connection.

WNetConnectionDialog@WIN32API.INC.desc: Starts a general browsing dialog box for connecting to network resources.

WNetDisconnectDialog@WIN32API.INC.desc: Starts a general browsing dialog box for disconnecting from network resources.

WNetGetLastError@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the most recent extended error code and text set by a WNet function (provider-specific errors).

Netbios@WIN32API.INC.desc: Interprets and executes the specified network control block (NCB). Provided for compatibility with NetBIOS applications.

RegCloseKey@WIN32API.INC.desc: Closes a handle to the specified registry key. Returns ERROR_SUCCESS (0) on success.

RegConnectRegistry@WIN32API.INC.desc: Establishes a connection to a predefined registry key (such as HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE) on another computer.

RegCreateKey@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates or opens the specified registry key. Provided for 16-bit compatibility; use RegCreateKeyEx.

RegCreateKeyEx@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates the specified registry key, or opens it if it already exists. Returns ERROR_SUCCESS (0) and the key handle in phkResult.

RegDeleteKey@WIN32API.INC.desc: Deletes a subkey and its values from the registry. The subkey must not have subkeys of its own.

RegDeleteValue@WIN32API.INC.desc: Removes a named value from the specified registry key.

RegEnumKey@WIN32API.INC.desc: Enumerates subkeys of an open registry key, one per call. Provided for 16-bit compatibility; use RegEnumKeyEx.

RegEnumKeyEx@WIN32API.INC.desc: Enumerates the subkeys of an open registry key, retrieving one subkey name per call by index. Returns ERROR_NO_MORE_ITEMS at the end.

RegEnumValue@WIN32API.INC.desc: Enumerates the values of an open registry key, retrieving the name, type and data of one value per call by index.

RegFlushKey@WIN32API.INC.desc: Writes all the attributes of the specified open registry key to the registry on disk.

RegGetKeySecurity@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves a copy of the security descriptor protecting the specified open registry key.

RegLoadKey@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates a subkey under HKEY_USERS or HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE and loads registry information from a hive file into it.

RegNotifyChangeKeyValue@WIN32API.INC.desc: Notifies the caller about changes to the attributes or contents of a registry key, synchronously or by signaling an event.

RegOpenKey@WIN32API.INC.desc: Opens the specified registry key. Provided for 16-bit compatibility; use RegOpenKeyEx.

RegOpenKeyEx@WIN32API.INC.desc: Opens the specified registry key with the requested access rights. Returns ERROR_SUCCESS (0) and the key handle in phkResult.

RegQueryInfoKey@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves information about a registry key, such as the number and maximum sizes of its subkeys and values.

RegQueryValue@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the data of the default (unnamed) value of a registry key. Provided for 16-bit compatibility; use RegQueryValueEx.

RegQueryValueEx@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the type and data of a named value of an open registry key. lpcbData gives the buffer size in and the data size out.

RegReplaceKey@WIN32API.INC.desc: Replaces the file backing a registry key and its subkeys with another file; takes effect the next time the system starts.

RegRestoreKey@WIN32API.INC.desc: Reads registry information from a file and copies it over the specified key and its subkeys.

RegSaveKey@WIN32API.INC.desc: Saves the specified registry key and all of its subkeys and values to a new file.

RegSetKeySecurity@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the security descriptor of an open registry key.

RegSetValue@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the default value of a registry key as a string. Provided for 16-bit compatibility; use RegSetValueEx.

RegSetValueEx@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the data and type of a named value under an open registry key. Returns ERROR_SUCCESS (0) on success.

RegUnLoadKey@WIN32API.INC.desc: Unloads the specified registry key and its subkeys that were loaded with RegLoadKey.

InitiateSystemShutdown@WIN32API.INC.desc: Initiates a shutdown and optional restart of the local or a remote computer, optionally displaying a message and timeout. Requires the shutdown privilege.

AbortSystemShutdown@WIN32API.INC.desc: Stops a system shutdown that was started with InitiateSystemShutdown during its timeout period.

ChangeServiceConfig@WIN32API.INC.desc: Changes the configuration parameters of a service (start type, binary path, account, etc.).

CloseServiceHandle@WIN32API.INC.desc: Closes a handle to a service control manager or service object.

ControlService@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sends a control code (such as stop or pause) to a service and returns its latest status in a SERVICE_STATUS structure.

CreateService@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates a service object and adds it to the specified service control manager database. Returns a service handle, or 0 on failure.

DeleteService@WIN32API.INC.desc: Marks the specified service for deletion from the service control manager database.

EnumDependentServices@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the name and status of each service that depends on the specified service.

EnumServicesStatus@WIN32API.INC.desc: Enumerates services in the service control manager database, returning name and status of each.

GetServiceKeyName@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the service name of the specified service from its display name.

GetServiceDisplayName@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the display name of the specified service from its service name.

LockServiceDatabase@WIN32API.INC.desc: Requests ownership of the service control manager database lock. Obsolete; the lock is no longer meaningful.

NotifyBootConfigStatus@WIN32API.INC.desc: Reports the boot status to the service control manager, marking the current configuration as last-known-good or not.

OpenSCManager@WIN32API.INC.desc: Establishes a connection to the service control manager on a computer and opens its database. Returns a handle, or 0 on failure.

OpenService@WIN32API.INC.desc: Opens an existing service with the requested access. Returns a service handle, or 0 on failure.

QueryServiceConfig@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the configuration parameters of the specified service into a QUERY_SERVICE_CONFIG structure.

QueryServiceLockStatus@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the lock status of the specified service control manager database.

QueryServiceObjectSecurity@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves a copy of the security descriptor associated with a service object.

QueryServiceStatus@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the current status of the specified service into a SERVICE_STATUS structure.

RegisterServiceCtrlHandler@WIN32API.INC.desc: Registers a function to handle service control requests; called from a service's ServiceMain. Returns a status handle for SetServiceStatus.

SetServiceObjectSecurity@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the security descriptor of a service object.

SetServiceStatus@WIN32API.INC.desc: Updates the service control manager's status information for the calling service.

StartServiceCtrlDispatcher@WIN32API.INC.desc: Connects the main thread of a service process to the service control manager, which then calls the service's ServiceMain.

StartService@WIN32API.INC.desc: Starts a service, optionally passing arguments to its ServiceMain function.

UnlockServiceDatabase@WIN32API.INC.desc: Unlocks a service control manager database locked by LockServiceDatabase. Obsolete.

LZCopy@WIN32API.INC.desc: Copies a source file to a destination file, decompressing it if it was compressed with the Lempel-Ziv algorithm. Returns the destination size or a negative error.

LZInit@WIN32API.INC.desc: Allocates memory for internal data structures needed to decompress a file opened with OpenFile and returns an LZ file handle.

GetExpandedName@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the original name of a compressed file if it was compressed by COMPRESS.EXE with the /r option.

LZOpenFile@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates, opens, reopens, or deletes the specified file, preparing it for LZ decompression. Returns an LZ file handle or a negative error.

LZSeek@WIN32API.INC.desc: Moves a file pointer a number of bytes from a starting position in a file opened for LZ decompression.

LZRead@WIN32API.INC.desc: Reads up to a specified number of bytes from a file opened with LZOpenFile or LZInit, decompressing them. Returns the number of bytes read.

LZClose@WIN32API.INC.desc: Closes a file that was opened with LZOpenFile or LZInit.

ImmInstallIME@WIN32API.INC.desc: Installs an IME (input method editor) and returns an input locale identifier for it.

ImmGetDefaultIMEWnd@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the default window handle of the IME class for the specified window.

ImmGetDescription@WIN32API.INC.desc: Copies the description of the IME associated with an input locale to a buffer.

ImmGetIMEFileName@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the file name of the IME associated with the specified input locale.

ImmGetProperty@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the property and capabilities of the IME associated with the specified input locale.

ImmIsIME@WIN32API.INC.desc: Determines whether the specified input locale has an IME. Returns nonzero if it does.

ImmSimulateHotKey@WIN32API.INC.desc: Simulates the specified IME hot key, causing the same response as if the user had pressed it in the window.

ImmCreateContext@WIN32API.INC.desc: Creates a new input context, allocating memory for it. Returns the context handle.

ImmDestroyContext@WIN32API.INC.desc: Releases an input context created by ImmCreateContext and frees its memory.

ImmGetContext@WIN32API.INC.desc: Returns the input context associated with the specified window. Release it with ImmReleaseContext.

ImmReleaseContext@WIN32API.INC.desc: Releases an input context obtained with ImmGetContext and unlocks its memory.

ImmAssociateContext@WIN32API.INC.desc: Associates the specified input context with a window and returns the previously associated context.

ImmGetCompositionString@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves information about the composition string (reading or result string, attributes, cursor position) of an input context.

ImmSetCompositionString@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the characters, attributes, and clauses of the composition and reading strings of an input context.

ImmGetCandidateListCount@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the size in bytes of the candidate lists of an input context and the number of lists.

ImmGetCandidateList@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves a candidate list from an input context into a CANDIDATELIST structure.

ImmGetGuideLine@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves information about errors or guidance messages from the IME for an input context.

ImmGetConversionStatus@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the current conversion and sentence mode status of an input context.

ImmSetConversionStatus@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the current conversion and sentence mode status of an input context.

ImmGetOpenStatus@WIN32API.INC.desc: Determines whether the IME is open or closed for an input context. Returns nonzero if open.

ImmSetOpenStatus@WIN32API.INC.desc: Opens or closes the IME for an input context.

ImmGetCompositionFont@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves information about the logical font currently used to display characters in the composition window.

ImmSetCompositionFont@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the logical font to use to display characters in the composition window.

ImmConfigureIME@WIN32API.INC.desc: Displays the configuration dialog box for the IME of the specified input locale.

ImmEscape@WIN32API.INC.desc: Accesses capabilities of a particular IME that are not available through other IMM API functions.

ImmGetConversionList@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the list of characters or words resulting from converting (or reverse converting) a source string, without generating IME messages.

ImmNotifyIME@WIN32API.INC.desc: Notifies the IME about changes to the status of an input context (e.g. complete or cancel the composition string).

ImmGetStatusWindowPos@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves the position of the status window of an input context.

ImmSetStatusWindowPos@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the position of the status window of an input context.

ImmGetCompositionWindow@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves information about the composition window into a COMPOSITIONFORM structure.

ImmSetCompositionWindow@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets the position of the composition window.

ImmGetCandidateWindow@WIN32API.INC.desc: Retrieves information about the candidate list window into a CANDIDATEFORM structure.

ImmSetCandidateWindow@WIN32API.INC.desc: Sets information about the candidate list window.

ImmIsUIMessage@WIN32API.INC.desc: Checks for messages intended for the IME window and sends them to that window. Returns nonzero if the message was processed.

ImmGetVirtualKey@WIN32API.INC.desc: Recovers the original virtual-key value associated with a key input message that the IME has already processed.

ImmRegisterWord@WIN32API.INC.desc: Registers a string with the dictionary of the IME associated with the specified input locale.
